checks.name: a delayed inbox read paints 50 skeleton blocks, not a spinner
no page-level spinner stands in for the skeleton
an empty inbox renders its own empty state
an exhausted page offers no load-more control
a 500 on the unified read is announced with a retry
"Try again" re-issues GET /me/inbox/unified
a healthy read after the failure restores the list in place
a source the reader may not read renders a denied state naming the permission
the denied state belongs to the Mail view, not the whole surface
a partially failed source is announced as "Mail — 2 of 3 mail accounts unavailable" over surviving rows
a partial failure degrades in place rather than replacing the page
the degraded banner introduces no horizontal overflow
all four kinds render as distinct rows although every one carries id 900001
the list reports aria-setsize 4
every row variant exposes a native, named, tabbable button
no horizontal overflow in the populated list
viewport is 360 px
a page with more rows offers an enabled "Load more"
going offline relabels and genuinely disables the load-more control
the page observes navigator.onLine === false
being offline is announced in a live region
reconnecting restores the load-more control
load more requests the next page with the server's cursor
an in-flight archive of notification 900001 touches only that row — the broadcast, mail and approval rows carrying id 900001 and notification 900002 are untouched
the archive dispatched exactly PATCH /notifications/900001/archive

pendingSamples: Mail from Acceptance Harness: Acceptance mail row
cells.unobservable: Broadcast, mail and approval rows render no archive or delete control at all, so the KIND half of the pending gate has no DOM affordance to disable. What this cell proves is the ID half (a sibling notification stays idle) and that an archive keyed on a bare numeric id would have removed the three same-id rows of other kinds.
